suite.message: [Captain's Log]: "Lately, Caroline and I spend hours here every day. I think she misses home... Some days she swears to me she can still see Grand Island peeking over the sea of clouds."
[Captain's Log]: "Carise has fallen ill again. Mary Ann thinks it's the altitude, but I suspect it's the cold. We approach the north-east side of Pixiote, which is eternally encased in snow."
